items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including unauthenticated arbitrary code execution via webhooks (CVE-2026-48358) and malicious file upload (CVE-2026-48356).

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie and has been actively exploited.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-49
items.summary: This update addresses multiple critical vulnerabilities, including stored XSS leading to arbitrary code execution (CVE-2026-34686), path traversal allowing arbitrary file system writes (CVE-2026-34653), and incorrect authorization leading to security feature bypass (CVE-2026-34646).

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files using a polyglot technique to bypass validation. The fix was included in Magento 2.4.9 by May 12, 2026.
